title: Camera, AI, QA, documentation — 7 day delivery

items.title: Privacy scope, issue board and documentation skeleton
acceptance: Only timestamp, presence boolean and confidence are persisted by the default camera mode
Five fictional QA users; no fabricated real consent
GitHub issue/milestone board published and linked

items.title: ERD/API review and five-user consent checklist
acceptance: ERD matches model ownership
JWT identity selects employee; foreign device denied
All five test users pass no-consent, grant, replay, isolation, revoke

items.title: Agent expected versus actual event report
acceptance: App switches, upload boundary, pause, sleep and idle cases have independent expected events
Report is generated from the real sampler with fake OS inputs

items.title: OpenCV/YOLO presence demo and confidence threshold
acceptance: YOLO save/save_txt/save_crop explicitly disabled
Present/absent demo and pause verified
Human-labeled present AND absent samples collected without recording frames
items.remaining: Independent human labels and present/absent hardware rehearsal

items.title: Random Forest Low/Medium/High experiment
acceptance: Features and labels documented
Participant-disjoint holdout; seed and dataset checksum recorded
Synthetic results explicitly marked experimental; no official scores changed

items.title: Camera precision/recall, AI F1 and final integration QA
acceptance: Metric table records provenance and coverage
API, agents, frontend and browser integration tests pass
All PRs link issue and exact test evidence; known gaps remain visible
items.remaining: Real camera validation set and team PR evidence links

items.title: Live demonstration, README final and defense rehearsal
acceptance: Run the README demo from start to finish
Demonstrate consent grant/revoke, camera presence, AI experiment and QA report
Record presenter/date/evidence without video or personal data
